text:
ASM::fingerprint
Description
This iRules command returns the FP id if available. Returns 0 if not.
Syntax
ASM
::
fingerprint
Examples
when
ASM_REQUEST_DONE
{
log
local0.
[
ASM
::
fingerprint
]
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ASM_REQUEST_BLOCKING,ASM_REQUEST_DONE,ASM_REQUEST_VIOLATION,ASM_RESPONSE_VIOLATION
